lines.en: Do not startle the frog on the reeds.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一亮，林子就有了星。
lines.en: My tail lights up and the woods get stars.
I walk steadily on reed leaves.
Dew has dampened my wings.
This path is dazzlingly bright.
The wind pushes me toward the mangroves.

lines.zh: 针叶林那头，就是我的家。
lines.en: Past the pines, that is my home.
I follow the light ahead.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在松针旧路上。
lines.en: Every step lands on the old pine needle path.
You stepped into the circle I light.
In the taiga I blink and blink.
In the spruce night, I glow.

lines.zh: 针叶林一黑，我就点亮尾巴。
lines.en: When the taiga darkens, I light my tail.

lines.zh: 我的触角先探到了前面的枝。
lines.en: My antennae found the branch first.
The light on my tail blinks on and off.
The fallen leaves stand taller than me.
On the moss, I stay perfectly still.
Antennae drooping — I am sleepy.
Among wet blades, only insects chirp.
A woodpecker is drumming far off.
I rest beneath a mushroom cap.
My glow reflects in the puddle.

lines.zh: 针叶林的夜里，我点着一盏小灯。
lines.en: In the pine night, I carry a little lamp.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水汽里，我成群亮着。
lines.en: Through swamp mist, we glow in a herd.

lines.zh: 沼泽上，我一闪一闪地等。
lines.en: Over the swamp I blink and wait.

lines.zh: 复眼里，世界碎成很多块。
lines.en: In my compound eyes the world breaks into pieces.
My light blinks slower; I am sleepy.
My tail light has glowed all night.
So close, your shadow dims my light.
Your palm is open and empty.
Your fingers are thicker than a trunk.
Your sole hangs above me.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的灯还亮着。
lines.en: In the taiga, my lamp is still lit.

lines.zh: 你举着的玻璃瓶在反光。
lines.en: The glass jar in your hand glints.

lines.zh: 你站着，影子盖住一片草。
lines.en: Standing there, your shadow covers the grass.

lines.zh: 你上次也走过这片沼泽。
lines.en: You crossed this marsh before.
You have crouched down by the marsh.
Not Firefly? Then who?
My light flickers badly.

lines.zh: 一根触角折了，我歪着飞。
lines.en: One antenna is bent; I fly crooked.
I will put out your lantern.
My light dimmed and my legs are numb.
My wing is crumpled; let me smooth it.
Who knocked me off the leaf?
A crack split my wing case.

lines.zh: 沼地上空，我们二到四只。
lines.en: Over the swamp we come two to four.

lines.zh: 我的光闪得慢了，但还亮着。
lines.en: My light blinks slower, but it still shines.
My glow will not last.

lines.zh: 我明知有网，还是飞过去。
lines.en: I know the web is there, and still I fly over.
Over the marsh, a drift of lights.
Is that drop of honeydew sweet?

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我们一明一灭。
lines.en: In the taiga, we blink on and off.
You are holding the fruit too high.
I want to carry this light home.
The overripe fruit shines with sweetness.
My light is dimmer than glowstone.

lines.zh: 树脂的味道，我凑近看看。
lines.en: Smells like resin — let me get closer.
Let me lick that leaf once.
There is no room to yield on this leaf.
My glow fell into the mud.
I tumbled into a curled leaf.
Your boot kicks up a gust.
Shell's hard. I'm fine.

lines.zh: 翅膀撞上你，光点散了一地。
lines.en: My wings hit you and the lights scattered.
One leaf vein, and we share it.
We both stopped at once.

lines.zh: 你的鞋尖碰了我的触角。
lines.en: Your boot tip touched my antennae.

lines.zh: 你的袖子扫过我的触角。
lines.en: Your sleeve brushed my antennae.
I saved the brightest flower for you.
Flash three more times and I will come.
Fly toward where the lights gather.
Even under wet grass, we can stay warm.

lines.zh: 你身上有松针和雨的味道。
lines.en: You smell of pine needles and rain.

lines.zh: 今晚的树，就是我们的家。
lines.en: Tonight this tree is our home.
My tail light blinks on and off.
My wings whisper against the leaf.
I wait on the reed for your light.

lines.zh: 你的闪光，节奏和我一样。
lines.en: Your flash matches my rhythm.
This much glow is enough to take home.
I can carry this bit of pollen.
This petal is mine first.

lines.zh: 针叶林夜里的亮点是我。
lines.en: The glints in the pine night are me.

lines.zh: 沼泽的夜里，我们成群发亮。
lines.en: On swamp nights, we glow in swarms.
Dragging it, I cannot fly high.
I claim this piece of bark.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的光一明一灭。
lines.en: In the spruce forest, my light blinks on and off.
I tuck it into the bark first.
I'll keep this little glow.
One flash from me and you should run.
My tail light has locked onto you.

lines.zh: 针叶林的黑，被我点亮一小块。
lines.en: I light a small patch of the dark pines.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我点亮的那片林子。
lines.en: You stepped into the woods I lit up.
The snail's trail smells good.
The aphids under the leaf are mine.

lines.zh: 针叶林一亮一暗，那是我。
lines.en: That flicker in the taiga is me.
This little bug is one mouthful.
You are stuck in the mud; perfect.

lines.zh: 你正好停在我的叶子上。
lines.en: You stopped right on my leaf.
Eight eyes, all on you.
The one with the net has stopped.
You are heading deeper into the marsh.

lines.zh: 你踩断芦苇的声音很响。
lines.en: Your snapped reed was loud.
Your sweat is strong.

lines.zh: 针叶林里我的光最显眼。
lines.en: In the taiga, my light stands out.

lines.zh: 沼泽上的光点，都跟着我。
lines.en: Every light over the marsh follows me.
I've circled ahead of you.
You run like a gust of wind.
Your torch is sinking lower.
Farther ahead is deep water.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我还能亮很久。
lines.en: In the pines, I can glow a good while yet.

lines.zh: 针叶林的夜里，我亮一下。
lines.en: In the taiga night, I flash once.
Your footprints sink deep in the mud.
My flashes are coming faster.

lines.zh: 我的尾灯一闪，就算打完。
lines.en: One flick of my tail light, and it's done.
My flash is a warning.
You back off; I flash once.
I bump against your lantern glass.
I bumped your nose.
I strike, and the light goes out.
I just lit up — don't swat me.
Your hand will itch a while.
I kick your hand with all six legs.
I fly toward whichever side glows.
Six legs, and every one moves.
Out of the leaf litter, I light up.
Two more lights move nearby.
Barely lit, and already hungry.
In the swamp night I start to glow.
The conifer night is lit by me.

lines.zh: 松林里刚黑，我的灯才点上。
lines.en: The pine wood just darkened; my lamp is lit.
The lamp on my abdomen lights for the first time.
The marsh wind smells of rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 火把我腹部的灯烤灭了。
lines.en: The fire snuffed the lamp on my abdomen.
A tumble of light lands in the grass.
Muddy water fills my spiracles.

lines.zh: 萤火虫的光被气浪吹散。
lines.en: The firefly's glow is blown apart by the blast.

lines.zh: 我这点光，拢在翅膀底下。
lines.en: My little light hides under my wings.
The spell turned my glow blue.
My glow's dim; even crawling is slow.
When rain falls, my light dims.
In the void my glow goes out.
